description: Extract a PowerPoint deck into full-data, page-delimited Markdown — every text run, table, speaker note, and image — with unextractable data (vector metafiles, charts, OLE embeds) skipped but visibly noted on its slide, then prove losslessness with a 5-point machine audit. Use when the user asks to extract/convert a PPTX to Markdown, add a new deck to an extraction project, or regenerate a stale extraction. Related terms: PPT, PowerPoint, PPTX, slide extraction, 提取.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent transform artifacts correctly and preserve important structure?
Did the agent verify transformed outputs before completion?
